Ursula K. Le Guin is the author of "The Left Hand of Darkness
"The Left Hand of Darkness" explores themes of gender fluidity.
"The Left Hand of Darkness" was first published in 1969
Uruguay approved its Trans Law on 2018
Uruguay approved its Trans Law 49 years after "The Left Hand of Darkness" was first published.
